title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-edrt: C_R compact int/bstr encoding mismatch in TH_2
description: The fix adds missing C_R to TH_2_input using cbor2.dumps(c_r), which is correct per RFC 9528. However, `_validate_connection_id` normalizes compact ints (values -24..23) to single bytes, and `cbor2.dumps(bytes)` always encodes as bstr. If C_R is a compact int on the wire (via `_encode_connection_id`), TH_2 uses bstr encoding instead of matching the wire encoding. Both initiator and responder make the same error so they agree, but this violates RFC 9528's requirement that C_R in TH_2_input uses the same CBOR encoding as appears in message_2. Fix: either store the original CBOR type alongside the normalized value, or re-derive the wire encoding when constructing TH_2_input.
